description: This file contains test suite definitions for GatewayConnectionController, verifying its behavior through various unit tests. It uses the XCTest framework and custom testing utilities to check functionality related to user defaults, capability toggling, system commands, operator connection options, and last connection persistence.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionControllerTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains multiple unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController class, verifying its behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the display name defaults correctly when missing in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that the current capabilities reflect the toggled features based on user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that location commands are included when location is enabled.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures that dangerous system commands are not included in the current commands.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Tests whether operator connect options only request approval scope when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Verifies backward compatibility of operator approval scope request logic.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Tests that loading the last connection reads and correctly returns previously saved values.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Ensures that load last connection returns nil when the stored data is invalid.
